instruction: Set the computer's sound output level to 75 percent.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command:
pulseaudio --start
pactl list sinks | grep '^[[:space:]]Volume:' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g'

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to set system volume to 75%. Evaluator uses pactl command to check volume percentage, expecting '75\n' output. Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter - no custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Verified that pactl command returns volume percentage as integer (0-100) followed by newline. Volume 75% produces output '75\n'.
